sources: IBPS CRP CSA notification and call letter pages on ibps.in, recent cycles

admitCard.where: The CRP CSA section on ibps.in
admitCard.when: Call letter is released about one to two weeks before the exam
steps: Open ibps.in, go to the CRP CSA section and choose the call letter link for the stage.
Sign in with your registration or roll number and your date of birth or password.
Download the call letter and print it. IBPS does not post a hard copy.
Check the date, shift, reporting time and venue, and keep an ID proof ready.
carry: The original photo ID named in the call letter
A passport size photograph and other items only if the call letter asks for them
admitCard.note: The call letter for the local language test is separate and comes after the mains result.

answerKey.summary: IBPS has not released answer keys or question papers for the Clerk prelims or mains in recent cycles, and there is no objection window. Your first official feedback is the result and the scorecard.
answerKey.note: Unofficial keys from coaching institutes are useful for a rough score only. State-wise shortlisting and sectional cutoffs also decide the result.

result.summary: IBPS declares each stage on ibps.in. The scorecard follows within days and is available for a limited time.

stages.what: Qualifying only. Candidates who clear the sectional and overall cutoffs for their state are shortlisted for mains.
Decides the merit list. There is no interview in the Clerk selection.
Qualifying language test where applicable, then provisional allotment to participating banks, state-wise.

result.scorecard: The scorecard gives section-wise marks. Download and save the PDF when it opens.
